clearance_contract: See L14_CLOSED_CASING_CLEARANCE.json; native source evidence only; target front-panel mesh/control accessibility not certified.
export_material_policy: PLACEHOLDER material slots plus explicit JSON/packed-image extraction. Do not let glTF importer infer URP smoothness from Blender nodes. Exporter writes only six meshes and one identity room-local root.
export_bake: Export-only temporary evaluated copies bake their documented room-local matrix into vertex positions exactly once. Export root and every mesh node are identity; positions are room-local metres. Stored candidate matrices remain explicitly recorded.
